title: Air Conditioning Repair
shortDescription: Fast diagnosis, upfront flat-rate pricing, and long-lasting cooling repairs by licensed HVAC specialists.

symptoms.title: AC Blowing Warm Air
symptoms.description: Caused by low refrigerant charge, faulty compressor relays, or a blown dual capacitor.

symptoms.title: Strange Grinding or Buzzing
symptoms.description: Worn blower motor bearings, loose fan blades, or failing electrical contactor coils.

symptoms.title: Weak Airflow from Vents
symptoms.description: Restricted air filters, failing blower motors, or ductwork disconnections inside the attic.

symptoms.title: Frequent System Cycling (Short Cycling)
symptoms.description: Unit cycles on and off every few minutes without reaching thermostat setpoint, rapidly spiking power bills.

symptoms.title: Water Leaking Around Indoor Unit
symptoms.description: Clogged condensate drain lines or cracked drain pan overflowing into drywall, creating structural water damage risk.

process.title: Multi-Point Diagnostic
process.description: Technician tests voltage, pressures, and airflow across the indoor evaporator coil.

process.title: Clear Quote & Options
process.description: We explain the root cause and provide clear upfront pricing before touching any tools.

process.title: Precision Component Fix
process.description: Repairs executed using OEM parts straight from our fully stocked local service van.

process.title: Load Test & Verification
process.description: System cycled through cooling stages to confirm 18-22 deg delta T split and peak SEER.

title: Furnace & Heating Fix
shortDescription: Gas ignition troubleshooting, cracked heat exchanger safety checks, and blower motor restoration for winter warmth.

symptoms.title: No Heat or Lukewarm Air
symptoms.description: Failed ignition module, dirty flame sensor, or tripped thermal limit switch.

symptoms.title: Furnace Clicking Without Igniting
symptoms.description: Clogged gas burner orifices or faulty hot surface igniter requiring replacement.

symptoms.title: Yellow Burner Flame
symptoms.description: Incomplete combustion risk. May indicate carbon monoxide or improper gas-to-air mixture.

symptoms.title: Blower Running Continuously
symptoms.description: Faulty thermostat limit control or failing control board relay.

symptoms.title: Sudden High Heating Bills
symptoms.description: Restricted airflow, dirty heat exchangers, or leaky duct systems causing system strain.

scope: Heat Exchanger Integrity & Carbon Monoxide Test
Inducer Draft Motor Pressure Switch Check
Blower Assembly Amp Draw & Balance Check

process.title: Safety & Combustion Check
process.description: Complete flue exhaust and carbon monoxide safety verification.

process.title: Ignition Circuit Diagnosis
process.description: Testing electronic ignition sequence and gas pressure levels.

process.title: OEM Component Replacement
process.description: Installing genuine replacement igniters, sensors, or relays.

process.title: Heat Rise Certification
process.description: Cycling through full heating call to confirm spec delta T.

title: 24-Point Annual Tune-Up
shortDescription: Comprehensive electrical, mechanical, and airflow calibration that prevents sudden breakdown and saves up to 25% on bills.

symptoms.title: System Running Inefficiently
symptoms.description: Higher monthly electric or gas utility bills without changing temperature habits.

symptoms.title: Dust or Odors Upon Startup
symptoms.description: Accumulated debris inside coils, blower wheel, and air filter housing.

symptoms.title: Uneven Room Temperatures
symptoms.description: Static pressure imbalance or restricted airflow through duct returns.

process.title: Baseline Performance Audit
process.description: Initial measurement of amps, pressures, and temperatures.

process.title: Deep Clean & Flush
process.description: Clearing coils, drains, and internal compartments.

process.title: Electrical & Mechanical Tune
process.description: Torquing connections, testing capacitors, lubricating bearings.

process.title: Efficiency Certification
process.description: Final report delivered with actionable homeowner guidance.
